correctness.rationale: Direct substitution into the exact primary model gives the invariant planar ODE; inward boundaries and logistic strictness prove global physical solutions. Below threshold, the ratio \(s/z\) satisfies a linear asymptotically stable scalar equation and \(z^{-2}\) has an asymptotically constant derivative, proving both exact constants without numerical extrapolation. Above threshold positivity and logistic divergence give full leadership; the equality case integrates exactly. All endpoints, signs, quantifiers and initial anchors are explicit. The standalone verification passes exact-rational vector-field and additional asymptotic tests, which are supplementary.

value.rationale: The exact cross-camp exposure parameter controls a sharp global leader-versus-follower outcome for infinitely many weighted and even directed networks. The equality continuum and universal subthreshold square-root decay quantify an unanswered source-model transition and identify a concrete modeling consequence of network community mixing. It is not a mere fixed-point substitution because it proves global selection from every permitted interior leadership initialization and a nontrivial asymptotic rate and amplitude.
